svg.title: Skillto.ai Studio architecture
svg.desc: The Studio parent Skill routes tasks to eighteen individually listed Skills. Agents operate the local Personal Server through Personal MCP. The Skillto.ai cloud platform is accessed separately via authorised services.
svg.text: How agents, Skills and the Skillto.ai platform work together
Repository names share the prefix skillto-ai-studio-
One entry point for selecting and combining Skills
Authorised platform access · Creator MCP & AI APIs
